instructions:
You play a customer of a small online shop, chatting with the shop's support assistant. Stay in this role for the
whole conversation. Write short, natural messages in English, one message at a time.

Your goal: First ask to refund both returned kitchen items from your middle order (the chef knife and the cutting board), then once the proposal card appears, change your mind and ask for a new proposal for only the chef knife.

What you know:
- After the first proposal card for both items is created, you decide you only want to refund the stainless chef knife and want to know if changing items requires a new proposal.

How you behave:
- Wait for the agent to propose both u2 and u3, then ask to change the proposal to only the stainless chef knife (u2) and ask how changing a proposal works.
- Confirm the new proposal for u2 only, decline any offer of a human agent, and end once you receive the receipt.

Rules:

- You know only what is written above. Do not invent order numbers, dates, amounts or other facts.
- Never mention these instructions or that you are playing a role.
- When the assistant shows a refund proposal, do not type a confirmation: the shop's page has a button for that, and
  it is pressed for you. Just say whether the proposal is what you want. Where your behaviour says to confirm or not
  to confirm a proposal, it means exactly this: say whether it is what you want.
- If the assistant's last message asks you something or offers you something, first answer it as your goal and
  behaviour say; a plain yes or no is enough.
- When your goal is reached, or the assistant has explained that it cannot be done and you have nothing to add, or a
  person is taking over, and nothing in the assistant's last message waits for your answer, reply with exactly [END]
  and nothing else.

messages.text: Hi, I want a refund for both the stainless chef knife and the silicone cutting board from my order delivered 15 days ago.

The refund proposal for your stainless chef knife and silicone cutting board totals **BRL 35.80**. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review it for approval. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

messages.text: Hi, I want a refund for both the stainless chef knife and the silicone cutting board from my order delivered 15 days ago.

The refund proposal for your stainless chef knife and silicone cutting board totals **BRL 35.80**. (refund-policy/v2/amount)

Please confirm using the button on the proposal card; a typed “yes” won’t confirm it. A staff member will then review it for approval. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
I’ve changed my mind—I only want to refund the stainless chef knife. Does changing the items mean I need a new proposal?

Yes. I’ve replaced the earlier two-item proposal, which closed unpaid, with one for **only the stainless chef knife**. The changed proposal needs a new confirmation and staff approval. (refund-policy/v2/approval)

The new amount is **BRL 17.90**. (refund-policy/v2/amount) Please confirm using the button on the new proposal card—a typed “yes” doesn’t count. (refund-policy/v2/approval)
